title: Desk Ruling on Admission of a Commission Under a Programme
content:
# Desk Ruling on Admission of a Commission Under a Programme

A commission is taken under a programme of Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions only where the quoted total falls between the smallest and the largest commission value that programme is offered for. A centre stone is built around only where its weight falls between the smallest and the largest weight the programme admits, and the metal must be one the programme offers. A stone the customer supplies is worked with only where the programme accepts a supplied stone and only once the customer has signed the stone release the chain requires, and their verbal go-ahead does not stand in for that release. Stones taken out of an heirloom piece are remounted only under the programmes that admit remounting, and the piece they came from is photographed before anything is taken apart. A consultation deposit is taken before design work begins under the programmes that require one, and it is credited against the quoted total. Where the piece the customer describes falls outside every programme's range, the desk does not open a commission and the customer is referred to the atelier by appointment.

## The conditions, and the programme figure each turns on

| Condition | Programme figure it turns on | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Quoted total within range | The programme's smallest and largest commission value | The quoted total is neither below the smallest nor above the largest; a total equal to either end is within range |
| Centre stone within range | The programme's smallest and largest centre stone weight | The weight is neither below the smallest nor above the largest |
| Metal offered | The programme's metals | The metal settled on is one the programme offers |
| Supplied stone | Whether the programme accepts a supplied stone, and whether it requires the stone release | The programme accepts one and the commission record shows the stone release signed |
| Heirloom remount | Whether the programme admits remounting | The programme admits it, and the heirloom piece is photographed before anything is taken apart |
| Consultation deposit | The programme's consultation deposit | Taken before design work begins where the programme sets one, and credited against the quoted total |
| Designer | The standing the programme requires of a designer, and the designer hours it includes | The designer carrying the commission holds that standing |

## The stone release

Where the centre stone is one the customer supplied, the release is proved by the commission record: the record shows whether the customer has signed the release the chain requires, correlated to the commission by its commission reference, and it is read before the commission is opened. The customer's verbal go-ahead, however clear, does not stand in for a release the record does not show as signed.

## Outside every programme's range

A piece whose quoted total falls outside every programme's range is not opened as a commission; the customer is referred to the atelier by appointment.

## Boundary readings (hypothetical)

- A programme offered from USD 2999.00 to USD 19999.00 admits a commission quoted at exactly USD 19999.00, and does not admit one quoted at USD 20000.00.
- A supplied stone under a programme that accepts one, where the record shows the release unsigned: the stone is not worked with, whatever was said at the counter.
